meta-runner.name: Check release version is new
meta-runner.description: Compare the release version being processed against the last one already processed. Sets ALREADY_PROCESSED so the post-processing steps can be skipped instead of failing.

param.name: BUILD_NUMBER
param.spec: text display='normal' description='Version being processed (set by the preceding Fetch Release Version step)' validationMode='not_empty'

param.name: LAST_RELEASE_VERSION
param.spec: text display='normal' description='Last version already post-processed' validationMode='not_empty'
